lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我喜欢看书，听音乐，还喜欢爬山。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè, hái xǐhuan páshān.
lines.english: I like reading, listening to music, and also mountain climbing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 一个月一次吧。周末和朋友一起去。
lines.pinyin: Yī gè yuè yī cì ba. Zhōumò hé péngyou yīqǐ qù.
lines.english: Once a month. Weekends I go with friends.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō, lìshǐ shū, bàozhǐ dōu kàn.
lines.english: Novels, history books, newspapers - I read them all.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: For music, what do you like?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 老的音乐。让人安静、放心。
lines.pinyin: Lǎo de yīnyuè. Ràng rén ānjìng, fàngxīn.
lines.english: Old music. It makes people calm and at ease.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 爱好真多！你一定很开心。
lines.pinyin: Àihào zhēn duō! Nǐ yídìng hěn kāixīn.
lines.english: So many hobbies! You must be very happy.
